title: Yeasty Crunchy Peruvian Ham Solo-Dinner
description: A lacto-vegetarian-friendly Peruvian dish featuring crunchy parma ham and a yeasty flavor profile. This solo-dinner recipe is perfect for a quick and easy meal.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add the olive oil, minced garlic, and salt. Stir to combine.
Add the sliced parma ham to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes or until crispy.
Add the toasted and crumbled sourdough bread to the skillet and stir to combine.
Sprinkle the shredded cheddar cheese over the top of the bread mixture and stir to combine.
In a small bowl, whisk together the infused-oil, active dry yeast, and black pepper. Pour the yeast mixture over the bread mixture and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the bread is crispy.
Garnish with chopped scallions, fresh cilantro, and a squeeze of lime juice.
Garnish with additional chopped cilantro if desired.
Serve as a solo-dinner and enjoy the combination of crunchy parma ham and yeasty flavors.
This recipe is best served immediately, but can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
Reheat in a non-stick skillet over medium heat until crispy and golden brown.
